environment.measurement: Client wall-clock including round trip; small synthetic graph, not a scale benchmark

run_lookup.explain:
Results
    Project
        Node By Index Scan | (r:AgentRun)

step_lookup.explain:
Results
    Project
        Node By Index Scan | (s:Step)

dependency_traversal.explain:
Results
    Project
        Conditional Variable Length Traverse | (@anon_0)-[@anon_1:DEPENDS_ON*1..30]->(s)
            Node By Index Scan | (@anon_0:Step)

ready_steps.explain:
Results
    Limit
        Sort
            Project
                Filter
                    Aggregate
                        Optional Conditional Traverse | (s)->(d:Step)
                            Conditional Traverse | (r)->(s:Step)
                                Node By Index Scan | (r:AgentRun)

attempt_history.explain:
Results
    Sort
        Project
            Conditional Traverse | (@anon_0)->(a:Attempt)
                Node By Index Scan | (@anon_0:Step)

recent_events.explain:
Results
    Limit
        Sort
            Project
                Node By Index Scan | (e:Event)

latest_checkpoint.explain:
Results
    Limit
        Sort
            Project
                Conditional Traverse | (@anon_0)->(c:Checkpoint)
                    Node By Index Scan | (@anon_0:AgentRun)
